name: The Keys
blurb: One road, too many bridges, and a deputy who has seen everything twice.

signs.text: BRIDGE ICES BEFORE ROAD. IT IS 91 DEGREES.
NEXT GAS 40 MI. NEXT REGRET 2 MI.
IGUANAS HAVE RIGHT OF WAY. LEGALLY UNCLEAR.
HURRICANE EVACUATION ROUTE. YOU ARE ALREADY LATE.
WELCOME TO THE CONCH REPUBLIC. NO PASSPORT. SUNSCREEN MANDATORY.
LAST CHANCE KEY LIME PIE. NEXT LAST CHANCE 1 MI.
IN CASE OF HURRICANE THIS SIGN WILL BE IN THE NEXT COUNTY.
FISHING CHARTERS DAILY. FISH NOT INCLUDED.

billboards.text: OWN A PIECE OF PARADISE. SOME PIECES STILL ABOVE WATER.
WRECKED LIVE. NEW EPISODES EVERY CRASH.
INJURED ON A BRIDGE? YOU PROBABLY DESERVED IT. THE LAW OFFICE OF NOBODY.
GATOR GARY'S AIRBOAT TOURS. SEE A GATOR OR SEE GARY.
LOBSTER LOTION. FOR WHEN THE SUN WON.
LANDFALL LIQUORS. OPEN THROUGH EVERY STORM. MOSTLY.
FLAT CALM CHARTERS. YOU WILL CATCH SOMETHING. PROBABLY SUN.

meta.notes: M1 stub; the traffic lane owns this file. Since M2 traffic-3 the mix, pedestrian and animal weights reach the race (SimTrafficTypeDef.weight) and pick the kinds; a kind listed nowhere never spawns. The weights started as M1's per-category defaults (car 5, truck 2, and 1 each for pedestrians and animals, where a `pedestrians` roadside zone gets the odd stray animal). M3 traffic-4 (head start, 2026-10-01) adds a wasteland oddity to the mix (a runaway mobile home, 0.3, scaled in-race by the `traffic.oddities` slider) and the Keys animals (iguana, pelican, gator, and a gator on a lawn chair). The `parked-boat` type and its code are in, but it stays out of this mix until the rivals can steer round a stopped vehicle: in CI's 50-race batch, rivals stalled behind parked boats for up to 328 s. All six new types are drafts, so release builds leave them out until they are promoted. Key deer stay out: a protected species (M3.md traffic-4). The signs and billboards are the placeholder items from the content-pack doc's region stub (M2 traffic-3), for road-3's `billboard` slots; each id is stable, so the in-game veto can name it.
